scope: SSE/SZSE holder-count observations; timestamp-format extension only.

announcement_format.precision: Date-only uses session close; full timestamp retains supplier time as best-effort vendor availability. Raw is unchanged.

unkeyed_empty_observation.condition: end_date is null AND holder_num is null, with valid security and announcement
unkeyed_empty_observation.raw: retain unchanged; summary records each excluded source row index
unkeyed_empty_observation.canonical: no economic report key or value can be asserted; do not manufacture a report period or canonical holder fact
unkeyed_empty_observation.validation: missing period with a non-null holder count still fails
unkeyed_empty_observation.qualification: explicit source record qualification, visible through the immutable Raw summary
